blocks.text: Grade 9 高频词汇 001–100
caveat /'keiviæt/ n. 中止诉讼程序的申请, 警告；[经] 停止支付的广告, 货物出门概不退换
(An important caveat, however, is that neither of these studies take humidity or sunshine into account, two major factors when it comes to assessing the influence of summer weather on behavior.)
中文语境：（然而，一个重要的警告是，这些研究都没有考虑湿度或阳光，这是评估夏季天气对行为影响的两个主要因素。）
glucose /'gluːkəus/ n. 葡萄糖；[化] 葡萄糖; 右旋糖; 葡糖(用于复合词中)
Maybe best of all, blistering heat does give us a perfectly good reason to eat ice cream: studies have shown again and again that blood glucose levels are tied to cognitive performance and willpower.
中文语境：也许最重要的是，酷热确实给了我们吃冰淇淋的充分理由：研究一次又一次表明，血糖水平与认知能力和意志力有关
meticulous /mə'tikjuləs/ adj. 一丝不苟的, 精确的, 过细的

In his meticulous diaries, written from 1846 to 1882, the Harvard librarian John Langdon Sibley complains often about the withering summer heat: "The heat wilts & enervates me & makes me sick," he wrote in 1852.
中文语境：哈佛图书馆员约翰·兰登·西布利 (John Langdon Sibley) 在 1846 年至 1882 年写下的细致日记中，经常抱怨炎热的夏季："炎热使我枯萎、虚弱、让我生病，"他在 1852 年写道
enervate /'enəveit/ v.t. 使衰弱；adj. 衰弱的, 无力的

In his meticulous diaries, written from 1846 to 1882, the Harvard librarian John Langdon Sibley complains often about the withering summer heat: "The heat wilts & enervates me & makes me sick," he wrote in 1852.
中文语境：哈佛图书馆员约翰·兰登·西布利 (John Langdon Sibley) 在 1846 年至 1882 年写下的细致日记中，经常抱怨炎热的夏季："炎热使我枯萎、虚弱、让我生病，"他在 1852 年写道
lapse /læps/ n. 过失, 流逝, 失效；v.i. 犯错, 堕落, 减退, 消失, 流逝；v.t. 使失效

In 1994, Gerald Clore, a pioneer in researching how ambient mood-altering phenomena affect cognition and judgment, found that pleasant weather can often lead to a disconcerting lapse in thoughtfulness.
中文语境：1994 年，研究环境情绪改变现象如何影响认知和判断的先驱杰拉尔德·克洛尔 (Gerald Clore) 发现，宜人的天气常常会导致令人不安的思考失误
paraphernalia /.pærəfə'neiliə/ n. 随身用具
The original paraphernalia for the lottery had been lost long ago, and the black box now resting on the stool had been put into use even before Old Man Warner, the oldest man in town, was born.
中文语境：原来的彩票用具早已丢失，现在放在凳子上的黑匣子甚至在镇上最年长的华纳老人出生之前就已经投入使用
perfunctory /pə'fʌŋktəri/ adj. 敷衍的, 随随便便的, 得过且过的

...the lottery; at one time, some people remembered, there had been a recital of some sort, performed by the official of the lottery, a perfunctory, tuneless chant that had been rattled off duly each year; some people believed that the official of the lottery used to stand just so when he said or sang it, others believed that he was supposed to walk...
中文语境：...彩票；一些人记得，有一次，抽奖官员举行了一场某种形式的朗诵会，每年都会按时朗诵一首敷衍的、不合调的歌谣。有些人认为，抽奖官员过去是站着说话或唱歌的，其他人则认为他应该走路......
gustatory /'gʌstətəri/ adj. 尝味的, 味觉的；[医] 味觉的, 味的
Only Harold and Maria, a Canadian couple, passed on the gustatory familiarity.
中文语境：只有加拿大夫妇哈罗德和玛丽亚传承了这种味觉上的熟悉感
unsuspecting /.ʌnsə'spektiŋ/ adj. 不怀疑的, 无疑虑的, 信任的；[法] 无怀疑的, 信任的
Primetime put seven other unsuspecting test subjects on the hot seat.
中文语境：黄金时段让另外七名毫无戒心的测试对象陷入困境
candid /'kændid/ adj. 坦白的, 率直的, 公正的
It was a classic episode on the old Candid Camera show - people getting on an elevator and turning backward just because everyone else did, and we all laughed.
中文语境：这是老偷拍节目中的一个经典情节--人们登上电梯并向后转，只是因为其他人都这样做了，我们都笑了
familiarity /fə.mili'æriti/ n. 熟悉, 精通, 亲密
Only Harold and Maria, a Canadian couple, passed on the gustatory familiarity.
中文语境：只有加拿大夫妇哈罗德和玛丽亚传承了这种味觉上的熟悉感
peril /'peril/ n. 危险, 冒...之险, 险境, 险因；v.t. 置...于险境, 冒险, 危及
Like birds in a flock or sheep in a pasture, we follow - sometimes at our own peril.
中文语境：就像鸟群中的鸟儿或牧场上的羊一样，我们跟随--有时我们自己承担危险
imprudent /im'pruːdənt/ adj. 轻率的, 鲁莽的
"After the debacle in Russia I left the country, for it was imprudent for an officer of the Czar to stay there.
中文语境："在俄罗斯惨败之后，我离开了这个国家，因为沙皇军官留在那里是不明智的
seafaring /'siː.fєəriŋ/ n. 航海业, 航海；adj. 航海的, 在海上工作的
All I could get out of him was: `This place has an evil name among seafaring men, sir.' Then he said to me, very gravely: `Don't you feel anything?' - as if the air about us was actually poisonous.
中文语境：我能从他那里得到的只是："这个地方在航海者中享有恶名，先生。"然后他非常严肃地对我说："你没有感觉到什么吗？" - 好像我们周围的空气实际上是有毒的
inane /i'nein/ adj. 空虚的, 愚蠢的, 空洞的；n. 空洞乏物

We knew he was afraid; his fingers were pulling with a separate life at the collar of his shirt, and maybe because she felt badly for him, Wendy answered instead: "Is your name Charles?" It sounded inane, but the man in the well answered.
中文语境：我们知道他害怕；他的手指带着独立的生命拉扯着他的衬衫领子，也许是因为她为他感到难过，温蒂回答道："你叫查尔斯吗？"这听起来很愚蠢，但井里的人却回答了
turbulent /'təːbjulənt/ adj. 狂暴的, 骚乱的, 紊乱的

There was a feeling to those days, months actually, that I can't describe without resorting to the man in the well, as if through a great whispering, like a gathering of clouds, or the long sound, the turbulent wreck of the ocean.
中文语境：那些日子，实际上是几个月，有一种感觉，如果不求助于井里的人，我就无法描述，仿佛通过巨大的低语，如云彩的聚集，或长长的声音，大海的汹涌残骸
dialogue /'daiəlɒg/ n. 对话；v.i. 对话；v.t. 用对话表达
Now that we had established some sort of a dialogue, everyone had questions he or she wanted to ask the man in the well, but the man wouldn't stop speaking:
中文语境：现在我们已经建立了某种对话，每个人都有问题想问井里的人，但那人却不停地说：
self-assertion /'selfə'səːʃən/ n. 自作主张；[法] 一意孤行, 坚持自己的权利
What could love, the unsolved mystery, count for in the face of this possession of self-assertion which she suddenly recognized as the strongest impulse of her being!
中文语境：面对这种自我主张，她突然意识到这是她存在中最强烈的冲动，爱情这个未解之谜又有什么意义呢！
abandonment /ə'bændəmənt/ n. 放弃, 抛弃, 放纵；[经] 委付, 废弃, 放弃(采矿权)
She wept at once, with sudden, wild abandonment, in her sister's arms.
中文语境：她立刻在姐姐的怀里哭了起来，突然间，她被抛弃了
exalted /ig'zɒːltid/ adj. 高尚的, 尊贵的, 高位的, 兴奋的
A clear and exalted perception enabled her to dismiss the suggestion as trivial.
中文语境：清晰而崇高的感知使她认为这个建议微不足道
self-assured /selfə'ʃjəd; (?@) -'ʃjərd/ adj. 有自信的
Assertiveness and self-control - These are the skills you need to be self-assured and confident without being aggressive.
中文语境：自信和自我控制--这些是你需要自信和自信但又不具有攻击性的技能
to-do /tə'duː, tu'duː/ n. 嚷闹, 骚扰
It's the skills that allow you to take care of your possessions, your finances, your studies, your to-do lists, your time, to name a few!
中文语境：这些技能可以让你照顾你的财产、你的财务、你的学习、你的待办事项清单、你的时间等等！
nutritious /njuː'triʃəs/ adj. 滋养的, 营养的；[医] 有营养的
You can read about it or ask a health professional about nutritious foods.
中文语境：您可以阅读相关内容或向健康专业人士询问有关营养食品的信息
self-awareness /,selfə'weənis/ n. 自我意识
Self-awareness and empathy - Self-awareness is the ability you need to understand yourself, your emotions, feelings, motives and desires, especially in relation to others.
中文语境：自我意识和同理心 - 自我意识是您了解自己、您的情绪、感受、动机和愿望（尤其是与他人的关系）所需的能力
finance /fai'næns/ n. 财政, 财务；v.t. 供给...经费, 负担经费；v.i. 筹措资金
The term refers to a range of skills, from managing your finances and your relationships, to how well you perform at school.
中文语境：该术语指的是一系列技能，从管理财务和人际关系到在学校的表现
pithy /'piθi/ adj. 有髓的, 由髓组成的, 简洁有力的
I wanted to say something pithy and victorious.
中文语境：我想说一些精辟而胜利的话
lavender /'lævində/ n. 熏衣草, 淡紫色；adj. 淡紫色的；v.t. 用熏衣草熏

Although My Employer was frequently gone from the estate, either traveling overseas or giving luncheons in Manhattan, I could feel the polite disdain of her gaze upon me at all times - while ironing her expensive blouses with lavender perfume, for instance.
中文语境：尽管我的雇主经常离开庄园，要么出国旅行，要么在曼哈顿举办午餐会，但我始终能感觉到她对我的礼貌的蔑视--例如，在用薰衣草香水熨烫她昂贵的衬衫时
yacht /jɒt/ n. 快艇, 游艇；v.i. 驾游艇, 乘游艇
At one point the couple invited me for a dinner on their yacht and then made me clean up afterward.
中文语境：有一次，这对夫妇邀请我在他们的游艇上吃晚饭，然后让我清理干净
clueless /ˈkluːləs/ adj. 无能的, 笨的
But these moments can also be sad, as some of these people seem to be totally "clueless" and believe they are incredible singers.
中文语境：但这些时刻也可能令人悲伤，因为其中一些人似乎完全"无知"，并相信自己是令人难以置信的歌手
bossy /'bɒsi/ adj. 专横的, 浮雕装饰的
Maybe one time they were really quiet and serious, and then another they seemed silly and childish, and the next time bossy and demanding.
中文语境：也许有一次他们真的很安静和严肃，然后另一次他们就显得愚蠢和幼稚，而下一次他们就显得专横和苛刻
irritate /'iriteit/ v.t. 激怒, 使发怒, 使兴奋, 使发炎；v.i. 引起不快
It is very likely that if you've had to spend any significant amount of time with a person like this, you found yourself feeling confused and irritated.
中文语境：如果你不得不花大量的时间和这样的人在一起，你很可能会发现自己感到困惑和恼怒
indicate /'indikeit/ v.t. 显示, 象征, 指示, 指出；[医] 指示
It is also worth noticing that people whose self-image and behavior vary drastically may be dealing with an emotional problem, and this might indicate a need for professional care.
中文语境：还值得注意的是，自我形象和行为差异巨大的人可能正在处理情感问题，这可能表明需要专业护理
excitability /ik.saitə'biliti/ n. 易兴奋性, 兴奋性, 激动性；[医] 应激性, 刺激感受性, 兴奋性

Desperate gambling on the Stock Exchange, wild speculation and the excitability which he could not get over even in advancing years, had by degrees led to the decline of his fortune and the proud, fearless, self-confident millionaire had become a banker of middling rank, trembling at every rise and fall in his investments.
中文语境：证券交易所的拼命赌博、疯狂的投机以及年老后仍无法克服的兴奋，逐渐导致他的财产逐渐缩水，这位骄傲、无所畏惧、自信的百万富翁变成了一个中等银行家，对投资的每一次涨跌都感到颤抖
ethereal /i'θiriəl/ adj. 轻的, 飘渺的, 天上的；[医] 醚制的, 挥发性的
Beauties as ethereal as clouds, created by the magic of your poets and geniuses, have visited me at night, and have whispered in my ears wonderful tales that have set my brain in a whirl.
中文语境：你们诗人和天才的魔法所创造的如云般飘逸的美人，在夜间拜访了我，在我耳边低语着令我头脑混乱的精彩故事
comely /'kʌmli/ adj. 清秀的, 标致的, 美丽的
I have heard the singing of the sirens, and the strains of the shepherds' pipes; I have touched the wings of comely devils who flew down to converse with me of God...
中文语境：我听见塞壬的歌声和牧羊人的笛声；我触摸到了美丽恶魔的翅膀，它们飞下来与上帝的我交谈......
aggressiveness n. (贬)侵略, 侵犯, 寻衅, (褒)敢作敢为, 有进取心, (武器)攻击性, 过分, 放肆
Teachers also rated these kindergarten students on their aggressiveness, but researchers find that these ratings do not predict whether kids will get in trouble with the police 15 to 20 years later.
中文语境：老师们还对这些幼儿园学生的攻击性进行了评分，但研究人员发现，这些评分并不能预测孩子们在 15 到 20 年后是否会遇到警察的麻烦
interpersonal /.intə'pəːsənəl/ adj. 人与人之间的, 人际(关系)的；[法] 人与人之间的, 需要与他人接触的

There's been a lot of interest recently in early childhood education programs, and some analyses of these early intensive programs suggest the real value is less about boosting cognitive skills like reading and math and more about boosting these interpersonal social and emotional skills.
中文语境：最近人们对幼儿教育项目产生了很大的兴趣，对这些早期强化项目的一些分析表明，真正的价值不是提高阅读和数学等认知技能，而是更多地提高这些人际社交和情感技能
positive /'pɒzitiv/ adj. 肯定的, 积极的, 有把握的；[医] 正的, 阳性的

The optimistic thing about this research, Audie, is that it looks like many of these skills actually can be taught and learned and developed, and this research seems to suggest it has really positive long-term outcomes.
中文语境：奥迪，这项研究的乐观之处在于，看起来许多这些技能实际上可以教授、学习和发展，而且这项研究似乎表明它具有真正积极的长期成果
subside /səb'said/ v.i. 沉淀, 沉降, 平息
Then leaf subsides to leaf.
中文语境：然后叶子退化为叶子
grief /griːf/ n. 伤心, 忧愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 灾难
So Eden sank to grief,
中文语境：于是伊甸陷入悲伤，
heroine /'herəuin/ n. 巾帼英雄, 烈妇, 女主角；[化] 海洛因; 二醋吗啡; 二乙酰吗啡

Heroes or heroines tend to be born in an extraordinary way, (think of the DC Comics Superman, the sole survivor from the planet Krypton who was saved by his father and sent in a rocket to planet Earth), are often brought...
中文语境：英雄或女英雄往往以一种非同寻常的方式诞生，（想想 DC 漫画超人，氪星上唯一的幸存者，被他的父亲拯救并用火箭送到地球），经常被带到......
render /'rendə/ v.t. 回报, 给于, 付给, 汇报, 提出, 舍弃, 反映, 表示, 表演, 致使, 执行, 实施；v.i. 给予补偿；n. 交纳, 打底
In this rendering it was Jove (Zeus) who was to judge them.
中文语境：在这个翻译中，审判他们的是朱庇特（宙斯）
cardiac /'kɑːdiæk/ n. 心脏病患者, 强心剂, 健胃药；adj. 心脏的, (胃的)贲门的

The headline was terrifying: "Man dies in Taiwan after 3-day online gaming binge." According to the story, published on CNN in 2015, a customer at an Internet café died of cardiac arrest, likely caused by over-exhaustion and cold temperatures after gaming for hours.
中文语境：标题很吓人："台湾男子沉迷三天网络游戏身亡"。据 CNN 2015 年报道，一名网吧顾客因玩游戏数小时后过度疲劳和寒冷导致心脏骤停死亡
client /'klaiənt/ n. 客户, 顾客, 委托人；[计] 客户, 客户机, 客户机程序
For a client who has trouble communicating, the game might be a safe space where they won't have to try and read social cues.
中文语境：对于沟通有困难的客户来说，游戏可能是一个安全的空间，他们不必尝试和阅读社交线索
falsify /'fɒːlsifai/ v.t. 伪造, 歪曲；v.i. 说谎
Education agents in other countries are known to falsify student transcripts, assuming that an outstanding GPA is the ticket to admission.
中文语境：众所周知，其他国家的教育机构会伪造学生成绩单，认为优秀的 GPA 就是入学的门票
infraction /in'frækʃən/ n. 违反, 侵害；[医] 不全骨折
This is supported by a secondary school culture where teachers are under pressure to give students nothing less than an A, and counselors are told not to report disciplinary infractions to colleges.
中文语境：这得到了中学文化的支持，在这种文化中，教师面临着给学生不低于 A 的压力，并且辅导员被告知不要向大学报告违纪行为
rigor /'rigə/ n. 严格, 严厉, 苛刻, 严酷, 严密, 精确；[医] 寒战, 强直, 僵硬
Not only will the faculty love him, but he has the coping skills he needs to adjust to the rigors of life in a residential college setting.
中文语境：不仅教员们会喜欢他，而且他拥有适应寄宿学院环境中严峻生活所需的应对技巧
applicant /'æplikənt/ n. 申请者；[经] 申请人, 请求人, 谋事人
If their perspectives are of lessons learned or challenges overcome, these applicants tend to jump to the top of the heap at highly selective colleges.
中文语境：如果他们的观点是吸取教训或克服挑战，这些申请者往往会在选择性很高的大学中跃居榜首
modicum /'mɒdikəm/ n. 少量
If there's anyone who still has a modicum of redemption left in their life, it's a juvenile."
中文语境：如果说生命中还有一丝救赎的话，那就是少年了。"
mete /miːt/ v.t. 量, 测量, 分配；n. 边界, 界石
What's more, in many states, the penalty is mandatory, meaning neither judge nor jury is allowed to consider the youngster's age or background in meting out the sentence.
中文语境：此外，在许多州，处罚是强制性的，这意味着法官和陪审团在判处刑罚时都不得考虑青少年的年龄或背景
aggravate /'ægrəveit/ v.t. 使恶化, 使更严重, 加重
He was tried as an adult for aggravated murder and, under state law, received a mandatory sentence of life without parole.
中文语境：他成年后因严重谋杀罪受审，并根据州法律被判处终身监禁，不得假释
arbiter /'ɑːbitə/ n. 仲裁人, 裁决者, 公断人；[计] 判优程序
When leaders attempt to navigate the slippery slope of fairness, they will find themselves arbiter of public opinion and hostage to the politically correct.
中文语境：当领导人试图滑向公平的滑坡时，他们会发现自己成为舆论的仲裁者并成为政治正确的人质
subjective /səb'dʒektiv/ adj. 主观的, 个人的；[医] 主观的, 自觉的
Fair is not an objective term - it is a matter of perspective filtered by a subjective assessment.
中文语境：公平不是一个客观术语--它是一个经过主观评估过滤的观点问题
proffer /'prɒfə/ v.t. 提供, 贡献, 提议；n. 提供, 提议
While many dispute the source, whether it was proffered by Bill Gates or not, I tend to agree with the hypothesis:
